title: Find the fractional variables
heading: A Fractional Value Marks the Variable to Branch On
cases: 0-1 values: 0.5 and 0.25 are fractional, 0.0 and 1.0 are not
the fractional names come back in the order the solution lists them
a value within the tolerance of a whole number, such as 0.9999999, is not fractional
a value above 1 or below 0 is judged by its distance to the nearest whole number
